$description: 360shooter design tokens. Logical pixels of the 640x360 arena. Coders use only semantic (menu.*, hud.*, game.*) and component tokens, never raw palettes.

ice.$description: H-35: diamond currency and the Diamant gear set

sprite.$description: Fixed palette of the astronaut and the raygun, identical in every biome.

highlight.$description: helmet and eye shine, laser head

gear-ice-hi.$description: H-35: Diamant set, palette letter i (sprites-m8.js)

gear-ice.$description: H-35: Diamant set, letter I; also diamond currency

gear-lava.$description: H-35: Hoelle set, letter L (same as game.fire-ring)

diamond.$description: H-35: diamond count next to gold, shop header, prices; always with the diamond symbol

owned-bg.$description: H-35: shop tile GEKAUFT (with check mark), same as done-bg

selected.$description: H-35: selected shop tile / equipped item ring (2 px), plus triangle marker

flash.$description: H-14: power slot lights up once on store (200 ms), accent at 50 %

trail.$description: H-14: boss bar, lost HP piece after a hit (300 ms)

danger-dim.$description: H-14: boss bar fill while invulnerable, always with tag IMMUN and dotted frame

diamond.$description: H-35: result screen '+1'/'+3' diamonds, with the diamond symbol

ember.$description: Pyramiden: rising embers from the braziers

ward.$description: Guardian dog ward magic: fill at opacity.aura plus a dotted 1 px ring (shape, not only colour)

aura.$description: H-23: forest spirit aura. Fill at opacity.aura plus a 1 px ring at full opacity (shape, not only colour). Replaces 0x9b59b6 (2.6:1 on elf ground)

tier-0.$description: H-33: enemy tier tint step 0 = no tint (clearTint)

tier-1.$description: H-33: enemy tier tint step 1 'Glut', multiply (setTint), second cue is scale

tier-2.$description: H-33: enemy tier tint step 2 'Glut', multiply (setTint)

tier-3.$description: H-33: enemy tier tint step 3 'Glut' (stage 3 and above), multiply (setTint)

parry-fill.$description: H-33: quicktime circle fill, same glass as hud.glass

parry-circle.$description: H-33: quicktime circle edge (2 px) and its number

parry-approach.$description: H-33: shrinking approach ring (2 px), ends on the circle edge at hitAtMs

parry-perfect.$description: H-33: PERFEKT, circle turns gold, pixel star

parry-burst.$description: H-33: PARRY! shield burst ring around the astronaut (same blue as shield-ring)

parry-symbol.$description: H-37: tint of the monochrome fairy-tale symbol (sprite parry-symbols, setTint) in the circle centre; replaces the number

parry-decoy.$description: H-37: decoy circle: wavy edge (sprite parry-decoy-edge), no glass fill, no approach ring. Same colour as a real circle on purpose: shape, not colour, tells them apart

parry-hold.$description: H-37: hold circle, filled segments of the inner 8-step ring while held

parry-hold-track.$description: H-37: hold circle, empty segments of the inner ring

parry-target.$description: H-37: drag target: four corner brackets and target symbol (no circle edge, no fill)

parry-link.$description: H-37: dotted 1 px line from a drag circle to its target

parry-flag.$description: H-37: pebble trail order flag (filled tab) behind the number in hud.screen

parry-beat.$description: H-37: beat dots under the astronaut: 1 px frame empty, filled from the first beat on

pet-aura.$description: H-35: capybara aura 'warme Quelle': fill at opacity.aura plus a dotted 1 px ring and rising pet-steam puffs. Warm honey, never mint (game.aura) or ward blue: friendly, not a danger

gear-block.$description: H-35: Diamant set block: 2 px ring around the astronaut grows 16 -> 28 px in motion.duration.gear-block, no text

crit.$description: H-35: critical hit (Teufelshoerner): hit flash in this colour (setTintFill) instead of game.hit-flash, same duration.hit; no number (principle 8)

menu.$description: Own bitmap font (docs/design/assets/fonts.js -> PNG + XML for Phaser BitmapText). 7 px cap height.

hud.$description: Own bitmap font, condensed, 8 px tall.

3.$description: HUD timer and energy, gold in panels

tracking.$description: 1 font px between glyphs, times scale

lineGap.$description: font px between lines, times scale

menu-drop.$description: hard pixel shadow, offset 4/4, no blur

menu-bevel.$description: light edge top-left, dark edge bottom-right

hud-slot.$description: H-14/H-23: power slot button, fixed 40 at every k (PE-94); margin to the arena edge = round(space.2 * k) like all HUD panels

hud-slot-icon-scale.$description: H-14: upper limit of the icon scale; with the 16x16 item sprites slotIconScale gives 2 (4 px inset)

parry-radius.$description: H-33: quicktime circle radius in arena px (diameter 40, about 44 pt on iPhone), not scaled with k

parry-distance.$description: H-33: circle centre distance from the astronaut centre

parry-touch-slack.$description: H-33: extra hit tolerance around the circle for touch

parry-line.$description: H-33: stroke of circle edge and approach ring

parry-ring-start.$description: H-33: approach ring starts at radius x 2.5 and shrinks linearly to x 1 at hitAtMs

parry-symbol.$description: H-37: symbol frame 14x14 (12x12 shape + 1 px dark outline), centred in the circle, scale 1

parry-hold-r.$description: H-37: outer radius of the inner hold ring (2 px thick, 13-15), inside the circle edge (18-20)

parry-hold-segments.$description: H-37: hold ring steps, clockwise from the top, 45 deg each with a gap of 1 px

parry-target-radius.$description: H-37: drag target radius (= PARRY_RULES.dragTargetRadiusPx), brackets sit on its bounding box

parry-target-bracket.$description: H-37: arm length of each L bracket, 2 px thick

parry-target-step.$description: H-37: brackets move this far inwards once a drag circle is selected by tap (tap replacement)

parry-link-dot.$description: H-37: dotted link line, 2x2 dot every 4 px, from circle edge (r + 3) to the bracket box; follows the circle while dragging

parry-flag.$description: H-37: order flag 10x10 on the top-left of a pebble circle (box from -24/-24 to -14/-14 of the centre), digit Funk 1x

parry-beat-dot.$description: H-37: beat dot 4x4, 3 dots with gap 4, centred 24 px below the astronaut centre

parry-hint-y.$description: H-37: centre of the hint panel above the astronaut centre; panel = image x2 + 2 px padding + 1 px frame (riddle 54x54, scale 70x54), bottom edge at -75. If the top edge would come closer than 4 px to the HUD timer, the panel moves down; circles always draw above the panel

parry-hint-scale.$description: H-37: hint images (parry-scale, parry-riddle) are drawn x2 (exception to principle 3, like the boss), so the riddle is readable on the iPhone

parry-motif.$description: H-37: colour motif 16x16 left inside the PARRY! panel, gap 6 to the word

hud-timebar-h.$description: H-33: double shot time bar height, max(2, round(2k)), inside a glass strip 1 px around

hud-timebar-gap.$description: H-33: gap between chip bottom and the glass strip of the time bar

hud-petbar-h.$description: H-35: pet bar strip height (fixed like the power slots), above the slots

hud-petbar-gap.$description: H-35: gap between pet bar bottom and the top of the power slots

pet-offset-x.$description: H-35: pet stands this far beside the astronaut centre, on the side opposite the aim (switches with flipX)

pet-offset-y.$description: H-35: pet centre below the astronaut centre (feet level); bee flies at -10

shop-tile-h.$description: H-35: shop tile height (3 rows fit the panel without scrolling)

gear-preview-scale.$description: H-35: astronaut and gear in the gear window (integer scale); portrait in the player card stays 2

blink.$description: low energy, timer < 10 s, boss banner

hit.$description: white hit flash (enemies, boss bar fill)

store-flash.$description: H-14: power slot lights up once when a power is stored

trail.$description: H-14: lost-HP piece of the boss bar fades

parry-approach.$description: H-33: circle and approach ring appear at hitAtMs - 800 (not before the telegraph start)

parry-feedback.$description: H-33: PERFEKT / GUT / VERFEHLT label and circle state stay, then vanish

parry-burst.$description: H-33: PARRY! word and shield burst ring

parry-target-step.$description: H-37: brackets slide one step in (tap replacement); with prefers-reduced-motion they jump

parry-sleep.$description: H-37: 'z' rises 6 px above a head circle after a hit; with prefers-reduced-motion it stands still

parry-tilt.$description: H-37: scale in the hint panel tilts in 2 steps over this time; with prefers-reduced-motion it shows the end tilt at once

timebar-warn.$description: H-33: double shot time bar turns hud.danger below this remaining time (no blinking)

gear-block.$description: H-35: Diamant set block ring grows once

diamond-pop.$description: H-35: '+1'/'+3' diamond pops in on the result screen (4 steps); none with prefers-reduced-motion

hatch.$description: H-35: pet-hatch 3 frames once, then the pet appears

banner-blinks.$description: H-14: BOSS KOMMT! blinks 3 times (duration.blink), then stays; no blinking with prefers-reduced-motion

dim.$description: H-14: icon of a blocked power slot

ghost.$description: H-14: silhouette icon of an empty power slot

hover.$description: Q-45: power slot hover fill (hud.accent over the glass)

blink.$description: Q-45: alpha at the low point of a blink (energy, timer, boss banner)

aura.$description: H-23: fill of the forest spirit aura (game.aura)
